verification.releaseDisposition: Keep unverified game-facing controls release-locked. The promoted 0.3.19-pilot source was probed live on boot 1788472141-542542: Add Level completed a bounded one-way level-1-to-2 cycle with an independent player-info readback of level 2 (blood_max 300 -> 342 and trait_points 22 -> 23 confirmed a real gameplay postcondition), and the closed-game 89-file pretest save tree was restored with zero differences; that evidence is pinned at qa/pilot-evidence/dawnwalker-add-level-live-20260903T215316Z.json. The same session proved the 0.3.19 FName crash fix holds (a raw request string was rejected without an access violation) but exposed the roster-unwrap bug: live GetAllTraits() entries arrive wrapped on the table and numeric container shapes, so resolve_trait_id rejected every trait id with 'a trait roster entry was no longer valid' and Unblock Trait could not function. Version 0.3.20-pilot unwrapped every container entry before validation on all three read shapes; after its promotion and smoke launch it was probed live, and that session proved roster resolution works end to end (112 real traits enumerated; unknown ids rejected cleanly) and that UnblockTraitToLevel really commits to the requested level for active-tree traits -- but exactly one game beat late, so the same-dispatch readback stayed stale and the 0.3.20 handler reported failure on calls that actually succeeded. Version 0.3.21-pilot fixes that by deferring the verdict: a commit-pending unblock is re-read on later bridge ticks (bounded at 40, ~6 s at the 150 ms poll cadence) and only answered once the committed level is observable. The 0.3.21 promotion and live probe then passed end to end on boot 1788474671-718541 (Add Level 1 -> 2 with exact setter and read-only query readbacks, Unblock Trait Human_ToughSkin|1 committed to level 1 through the deferred later-tick verification and confirmed by the repeat dispatch, and the closed-game 91-file pretest save tree restored with zero differences; evidence qa/pilot-evidence/dawnwalker-add-level-unblock-trait-live-20260903T223408Z.json). addLevelLiveRun and unblockTraitLiveRun are both true. Historical 0.3.16 evidence (read-only and safe-reversible suites, Trait Points persistence) remains pinned at qa/pilot-evidence/dawnwalker-live-pilot-qa-20260903T082032Z.json, qa/pilot-evidence/dawnwalker-live-pilot-qa-20260903T082038Z.json, and qa/pilot-evidence/dawnwalker-trait-points-live-persistence-20260903T084603Z.json. This remains pilot evidence, not all-feature production proof.

capabilities.label: Unblock Trait
capabilities.exactTargetObjectOrClass: UCharacterDevelopmentSubsystem (game-instance subsystem), the same live object already verified for player:trait-points
capabilities.exactSetterFunctionPropertyOrHook: UCharacterDevelopmentSubsystem.UnblockTraitToLevel(FName InTraitID, int32 TargetLevel, bCanShowVideo=false, bShowNotification=false). CharacterDevelopmentSubsystem.h:191.
capabilities.readbackOrObservablePostcondition: GetTraitUnblockedLevel(InTraitID) must be at least the requested target level. The trait must first resolve through GetTrait(InTraitID); an unknown id is refused rather than silently unblocking nothing.
capabilities.disableOrRollbackPath: NONE. The pinned build exposes no BlockTrait or re-block inverse. The closed-game save backup is the only recovery path.
capabilities.rollbackLimit: One-way and save-backed. This is the in-game 'FIND OR BUY A MANUAL TO MAKE AVAILABLE' gate; unblocking is what makes a trait purchasable with trait points. An already-unblocked trait reports success without calling the setter again. A live 0.3.18-pilot probe crashed the game with an access violation before any save was written: GetTrait, GetTraitUnblockedLevel, and UnblockTraitToLevel all take const FName&, and the pinned UE4SS build does not marshal a raw Lua string into that parameter. The 0.3.19-pilot handler resolves the id against the GetAllTraits() roster and only ever passes the matched trait's own Skill_ID value. The 0.3.20 live probe proved that resolution works (112 traits enumerated; unknown ids rejected cleanly) and that UnblockTraitToLevel commits the requested level one game beat late, so version 0.3.21 defers the readback verdict to later ticks and a succeeded call is never reported as a failure. The 0.3.21 live probe then completed the cycle on boot 1788474671-718541: Human_ToughSkin|1 committed to level 1 with exact readback, the repeat dispatch confirmed 'already unblocked to level 1', and the closed-game pretest tree was restored with zero differences.
capabilities.offlineTestCase: DawnwalkerAddLevelPilot.Tests.lua also covers unblock: unknown trait id refusal, malformed id refusal, level bounds, already-unblocked no-op, exact readback, identity drift, roster resolution failures (unreadable, oversized, wrong-class, and duplicate rosters), wrapped remote roster entries (0.3.20), deferred-verification semantics (0.3.21): success reported only after the commit beat, supersession by a newer command, and bounded-window rejection for a level that never commits. It asserts that no raw request string ever reaches an FName-typed engine call. Run with npm run test:add-level.
capabilities.liveEvidence: qa/pilot-evidence/dawnwalker-add-level-unblock-trait-live-20260903T223408Z.json (0.3.21-pilot live probe, boot 1788474671-718541 on CL-256914/build 25107392: Add Level baseline 1 -> 2 with exact setter and read-only query readbacks, Unblock Trait Human_ToughSkin|1 committed to level 1 through the deferred later-tick verification, the repeat dispatch confirmed 'already unblocked to level 1', the active set stayed empty, and the closed-game 91-file pretest save tree was restored with zero differences per the embedded saveSafety record)
